label: ESSENCE_2: ESSENCE_2 F Φ x w: at w, x has Φ, and every property x has at w is had, at every world…
definition: `Essence F Φ x w`: at w, x has Φ, and every property x has at w is had, at every world accessible from w, by everything that has Φ there (AFP definition ess). This is the theory's modal notion. It is not the Thomist essence (what a thing is) and is not used by any Aquinas statement.
